user.title: Home Keeper — Valetudo consumables
user.description: Turns worn consumables of your Valetudo robots (via MQTT) into Home Keeper tasks. One instance covers every robot; tune it in the options afterwards.

abort.already_configured: Already set up — one instance covers every Valetudo robot.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Already set up — one instance covers every Valetudo robot.

error.limits_too_high: Low limit plus reset margin must not exceed 100 %.

data.reset_on_done: Reset the robot's counter when a task is marked done

data_description.threshold: A task is raised when a consumable has this much of its life left or less. Minute counters are turned into percent of their learned lifetime.
data_description.reset_margin: A rise of at least this many percentage points is read as a counter reset and records the replacement.
data_description.reset_on_done: Presses the consumable's reset button from Valetudo. If the robot is offline, the reset is repeated once it reports again, and the task does not re-arm meanwhile. When off, a task you tick off stays quiet until you reset the counter in Valetudo, and that reset is not counted as a second replacement.
data_description.stock_enabled: One appliance per robot with brushes, filters, mop pads and dust bags as parts. A replacement draws one spare; set a reorder point and 'Auto-create buy task' on a part to get a buy task. Cleaning chores have no stock.
